one_liner: Nikola Jokic averages 28.4 points, 12.8 rebounds, and 10.1 assists per 36 minutes -- a triple-double rate line from the center spot.
three_things: The 10.1 assists per 36 minutes is a guard-level playmaking rate from a center.
He pairs that with 12.8 rebounds and 28.4 points per 36 minutes across 210 games.
Scoring efficiency is high too: 57.6 percent from the field and 38.9 percent from three.
context_note: Numbers are per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not a full career; the manifest is descriptive_only, with no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor. A per-36 triple-double rate is not the same as per-game averages.
